assessments.reasoning: The title page gives FOCAL-8 and printed order number DEC-08-AJAD-D. The printing statement ends with the sixth, revised printing, dated January 1970. The preface at printed p. vii expressly calls FOCAL-8 the DEC service program for numerical problems on the family of 8 computers.

challenge.method: Checked the physical title and printing pages against the misleading AJAB-D scan filename, and compared the preface’s language description with its description of the service and optional expansions.
challenge.results: The printed order number and sixth-printing statement establish this representation’s January 1970 authority. The preface gives the bounded program and identifies the language it supplies. Its shortened use of FOCAL is specific to that manual.

limitations: The source locator filename retains AJAB-D. The printed evidence supplies AJAD-D. This review covers the documented DEC service identity and does not establish a particular binary or port.
